'''John Ratzenberger''' (born 6 April 1947) is an American actor, widely known for playing Cliff Clavin on the comedy series ''Cheers'' (1982–1993).<ref name="wp-jr">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Ratzenberger John Ratzenberger], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026025041/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Ratzenberger Internet Archive], 26 October 2026.</ref> He played Major Bren Derlin in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980).<ref name="wp-jr" /><ref name="ins74-52">"Hoth Freezes Over: Who's Who in Echo Base", ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #74 (2004), p. 52. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-d0e5c1/page/n47/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref>

The [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] card [[Major Bren Derlin]] ends its lore with "At the Mos Eisley Cantina, everyone knows his name." [[Decipher]]'s Art Show listed the line among its Easter eggs.<ref name="artshow-derlin">[http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/hoth/light/emajorbrenderlin.html Major Bren Derlin], Art Show: Easter Eggs, Decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000505095607/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/hoth/light/emajorbrenderlin.html Internet Archive], 5 May 2000.</ref>
